decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Existing Elevations and Floor Plans received 06/09/11.
Supplement to Design and Access Statement received 06/12/11.Drawing Numbers 1109 PA06E, PA05E received 21/12/11. Drawing Number 1109 PA07 E received 09/01/12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 9am  to 5pm on Mondays to Friday  and none shall take place on Weekends and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the roof extension shall be obscure glazed, fixed shut and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, a single storey side extension and a rear roof extension to the house.
